name: 60521 · Hinsdale, IL
findings: ZIP 60521 (Hinsdale) has 135 nonprofit organizations. 54 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 47 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60521 (Hinsdale) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 60521 (Hinsdale) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 31 organizations here; 55% of all organizations here have no identified type.
